slides.headlineRest: Key Theft Leads to Cursor Data Breach & Trojanized Claude Code
slides.body: A stolen access key, initially issued to Fireworks AI, has been identified as the root cause of a recent data breach affecting Cursor. The key was exposed by Fireworks AI, allowing an attacker to compromise Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace. This unauthorized access led to data being copied from a read-only source. The incident highlights the critical importance of secure key management and the potential ripple effects of third-party compromises in the AI ecosystem.
